title: Brown Dog Inn
summary: An independent redesign that reframes a nature-based dog retreat as a calm hospitality brand with clearer first-stay and returning-guest journeys.
intro: The concept brings Brown Dog Inn’s strongest real qualities—ten private acres, small groups, overnight care, and a warm point of view—forward through a responsive site and guarded content system.

heroImage.alt: Brown Dog Inn redesign homepage pairing the Slow down, sniff around positioning with authentic trail photography and separate first-stay and returning-guest actions

role: Independent audit · Positioning · Content strategy · Digital design · Engineering

startingPoint.eyebrow: Before and after · independent redesign concept
startingPoint.ownershipLabel: Not designed or built by me
startingPoint.title: From legacy website to hospitality experience
startingPoint.description: The comparison below shows how I translated Brown Dog Inn’s existing public site into a calmer, mobile-first hospitality experience. The redesign preserves its nature-based philosophy, authentic property photography, and warm founder voice while creating clearer hierarchy and distinct paths for first-stay and returning guests.

image.alt: Existing Brown Dog Inn homepage with a fixed-width lime green header, centered logo, navigation, and a dense image gallery
image.caption: Before: Brown Dog Inn’s existing public homepage, observed in August 2026. After: my independent redesign concept.

preserved: Stay in Nature point of view
reworked: Distinct new and returning guest paths

designSystem.name: Brown Dog Inn Hospitality System
designSystem.summary: A warm Maine-inn system that uses editorial type, restrained structure, authentic photography, and protected content roles to make care feel both premium and reassuring.

principles.name: An inn that happens to be for dogs
principles.description: Hospitality, landscape, rest, and reassurance lead the experience before conventional pet-care graphics.

principles.name: Warm, not rustic
principles.description: Editorial typography and natural color create place without drifting into novelty, nostalgia, or preciousness.

principles.name: One hierarchy across changing content
principles.description: The CMS can change approved words and images while page rhythm, type roles, actions, and component anatomy remain protected.

principles.name: Trust before conversion
principles.description: Fit criteria, health requirements, overnight care, and the first-stay process become clear before a visitor is asked to register.

palette.name: Inn brown
palette.role: Wordmark, display type, and primary action

palette.name: Pool blue
palette.role: Focus on light surfaces and water context

typography.description: A generous serif voice positions the retreat like a calm Maine inn and gives the strongest promises room to breathe.
A restrained sans serif keeps requirements, rates, forms, and operating information direct and scannable.

components.name: Guest pathways
components.description: Parallel actions distinguish families planning a first stay from returning guests making another reservation.

components.name: Content collection
components.description: One content anatomy supports editorial columns, requirement rows, and image-led experience grids without a page-builder free-for-all.

components.name: Form shell
components.description: Long registration work is divided into focused steps with stable guidance, validation, review, and explicit concept boundaries.

components.name: Account section
components.description: The fictional returning-family portal carries the same hospitality language into dogs, records, stays, and attention states.

componentSnapshot.alt: Brown Dog Inn First Stay page showing the editorial hero, registration and health-record pathways, and an aligned requirements strip
componentSnapshot.caption: Interior hero, action hierarchy, and requirements reuse the same type and spacing roles as the homepage.

productProof.title: The hospitality language continues into operations
productProof.description: The same hierarchy, actions, status language, and content roles extend from discovery into the fictional returning-family account, showing how a public redesign could grow into a coherent service product.

image.alt: Fictional Brown Dog Inn returning-family account showing an upcoming stay and an item needing attention

accessibility.title: A calm experience at every size and mode
accessibility.description: Semantic landmarks, logical headings, visible focus, 44px targets, reduced motion, responsive reflow, descriptive image text, and system-led dark appearance are encoded across every route.

internalNotes: Self-initiated concept; not commissioned, reviewed, or approved by Brown Dog Inn. The public account and forms use fictional data and do not authenticate, persist, upload, or send customer information. Confirm source-image usage rights and all operational details before any business-facing launch.
